tools.name: compareProducts
tools.description: Compare multiple products by product URLs using public product details, variant details, compare features, related products, and related articles.

productUrls.description: List of product page URLs to compare

tools.name: searchtool
tools.description: Search Gillette Venus for products and articles. Returns structured results with counts. Read-only.

type.description: "products" – product results only. "articles" – article results only. "all" (default) – both products and articles with counts.

tools.name: viewArticle
tools.description: View public article details by article URL. Returns article title, description, URL, related products, related articles, and official social links.

tools.name: viewProduct
tools.description: View public product details by product URL. Returns product title, description, URL, related products, related articles, variant details, and rendered rating summary when available.

tools.name: viewReviews
tools.description: View rendered BazaarVoice rating summary and review content for a product by product URL
